title: Larger AI moderation evaluation before trust graduation
description:
As an editor, I want a larger evaluation of the AI moderator, so that I can trust it before human moderation is turned off.

Context: the 12-case live check of AI moderation on PR #558 (GPT-6 Luna, Responses API, Structured Outputs) scored 11/11. That is too small to graduate trust. This does not block the Shipped launch, because the site moderation mode stays human.

Scope: 100+ cases per category (spam, abuse, off-topic, legitimate); non-English and coded abuse; prompt injection in the title and URL fields; repeated runs of every case for stability; sample audits of AI allows (what the AI let through that a human would hide).

```gherkin
Feature: Larger AI moderation evaluation
  Scenario: Coverage
    Given an evaluation set with at least 100 cases per category, including non-English text, coded abuse, and injection in title and URL fields
    When the AI moderator runs on every case
    Then the report shows the verdict agreement per category

  Scenario: Stability
    When every case is run several times
    Then the report shows how many verdicts changed between runs

  Scenario: Audit of allows
    Then a sample of the AI allows is reviewed by a human and the miss rate is reported
```
